concept.concept: Detailed botanical-style illustration of various wild mushrooms arranged in a grid with small handwritten Latin names beneath each
concept.audience: Mycology hobbyists and foragers, skewing 25-45, nature-forward lifestyle
concept.rationale: Mushroom foraging is a sustained growing niche with passionate repeat buyers; fall is peak foraging season aligning with the 6-8 week buying window; botanical illustration style differentiates from cartoon competitors; low brand-conflict risk

design.image_prompt: Flat vector illustration of nine wild mushrooms arranged in a 3x3 grid, each species distinctly different in cap shape, stem proportion, and gill pattern. Mushrooms include: fly agaric with red cap and white spots, chanterelle with golden funnel shape, puffball round and pale, morel with honeycomb texture, oyster mushroom layered and gray, death cap with pale bulbous base, honey mushroom clustered and amber, shiitake with dark umbrella cap, and boletus with thick stem and pores. Solid color blocks only—no gradients, no photorealism, no shading. Use five colors: cream, forest green, rust red, mushroom brown, and charcoal. Each mushroom outlined in charcoal. Centered composition on a solid white background with generous margins. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room. Screen-print aesthetic with bold simple shapes and clean sharp edges.
design.style: flat vector illustration, bold simple shapes, clean sharp edges, high contrast, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks, no gradients, no airbrush shading, no photorealism

verdict.reason: Botanical-style scientific illustrations of wild mushrooms with handwritten Latin taxonomic names are firmly in the public domain tradition of natural history illustration. No trademarks, brand names, characters, celebrities, or protected slogans are involved. Generic mushroom species names in Latin (e.g., Amanita muscaria, Cantharellus cibarius) are scientific nomenclature and not protectable. The grid layout and illustrative style are common artistic approaches with no IP concerns. This design presents negligible risk.

image_verdict.reason: Clean illustrated mushroom variety sheet with no text, no IP concerns, no recognizable characters or brands. Anatomy is consistent and well-rendered across all ten mushroom types. White background is suitable for garment printing. Generic botanical/nature illustration style.
